kpis.label: European allies pledged at The Hague to reach 3.5% of GDP core defence spending by 2035; Germany's draft 2027 budget envisages ~€139.6B of total defence spending (€109.7B regular + €29.9B special fund, not yet final), so the demand runway is intact even as UK fiscal strain clouds BAE's interim 3% target

kpis.sub: 2026 YTD · DEFENSE TECH VC, PAST 2025'S $9.6B FULL-YEAR RECORD

The stopgap (passed Sept 1, 370-48) leaves the Pentagon on $838.5B versus a $1.5T FY27 ask and blocks new starts: Golden Dome has no base topline to fall back on, F-15EX starts FY27 with $115M of a $2.65B request, and the $54.6B FY27 DAWG drone line cannot begin; one analyst suggests the base budget may not clear until spring 2027

kpis.sub: ANDURIL'S AIR FORCE CCA PRODUCTION AWARD · SEP 26
kpis.label: The Air Force named Anduril's FQ-44A Fury and General Atomics' FQ-42A Vengeance for CCA production — 150 airframes initially, scaling toward 500 by 2032 at roughly $20M/unit, split between the two — a production milestone that supports an eventual Anduril IPO regardless of when a primary round closes

private_watchlist.name: Anduril
private_watchlist.note: An employee tender opened Oct 13 (up to ~$1.3B at $94.80/share, closes Nov 9) values Anduril at ~$90B, up from $61B in May; it is a secondary sale with no new capital. The reported ~$100B primary round (first reported Jul 24, possibly two-stage with a later ~$110B tranche tied to benchmarks) is unconfirmed. The Sep 26 CCA production award (up to ~$5B split with General Atomics) is real production revenue.

private_watchlist.name: Shield AI
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the ~$2B round at $12.7B. Competes for the Navy's up-to-$800M ISR task-order pool with V-BAT alongside NATO eastern-flank orders.

private_watchlist.name: Saronic
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.75B Series D plus an early-September add-on. Building out its Port of Gulfport site toward 20+ autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Helsing
private_watchlist.note: No new financing this period; still marked by the $1.8B round closed Jul 13, the largest defence-tech round in European history. Continues fielding the HX-2 strike drone in Ukraine.

bear_case.title: The stopgap budget freezes the programs the growth stories depend on
bear_case.description: The continuing resolution runs to Dec 11 and leaves the Pentagon on $838.5B versus a $1.5T FY27 request; it blocks new starts for 150+ programs, Golden Dome has no base topline (most funding came via the 2025 reconciliation bill), F-15EX starts FY27 with $115M of $2.65B requested and the $54.6B DAWG drone line cannot begin; the base budget may not clear until spring 2027.
bear_case.counter: Congress has historically backfilled priority programs after a CR, and the reconciliation route could still deliver Golden Dome funding.

bear_case.title: Public-market valuations remain stretched
bear_case.description: Even after this week's ~5% pullback in drone names, Palantir (~$206-209 after the Oct 9 rally) trades at a premium multiple (~85x forward earnings last confirmed) and the S&P Aerospace & Defense sub-index sits near 32x forward earnings versus roughly 20x for the S&P 500 — a premium the sector has to keep earning.
bear_case.counter: Palantir's 92.8% revenue growth and rising EPS estimates are far faster than higher-multiple software peers.

bear_case.title: Private-market valuations are drawing bubble comparisons of their own
bear_case.description: Early-stage rounds price at 17x-50x revenue, Anduril's ~$100B primary round remains unconfirmed (the Oct 13 tender prices it at ~$90B), and the Bank for International Settlements has compared the sector's pricing to the AI-infrastructure buildout it already calls bubble-like.

bear_case.title: The Pentagon's drone competitions keep favoring private newcomers over listed pure-plays
bear_case.description: Gauntlet II leaders Neros and Perennial Autonomy won real orders (Neros: ~$100M for 14,000+ FPV drones on Oct 1), while Red Cat's Teal Drones, Ondas's Ascent Aerosystems and Kratos all missed the top five.

bear_case.title: Contract wins and beats aren't rescuing the pure-play stocks
bear_case.description: AeroVironment beat Q2 estimates ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and won a $464.8M laser award yet trades near $122 (~49% down YTD); Ondas reported $165M of new orders on Oct 7 and has since fallen to ~$6 (-35% YTD) despite a Palantir-linked AI venture; Kratos is ~$40 (-48% YTD). The JEDI drone ETF fell ~5% on Oct 14 alone.
bear_case.counter: The ~$232 consensus target implies substantial upside if backlog converts to earnings.

bear_case.title: Rheinmetall's rebound is fragile — execution, not backlog, sets the stock
bear_case.description: A ~20% one-week bounce to €1,090 still leaves it far below the €1,966 high, and Berenberg's Hold (target €1,020) cites valuation and a lack of recent large orders; delivery delays, negative operating free cash flow and the F126 loss make Nov 5 Q3 results a binary test.
bear_case.counter: Deutsche Bank (target €1,800) expects >40% Q3 revenue growth, and CEO and board-linked insider purchases in late September/October suggest management sees the earlier de-rating as overdone.

bear_case.title: UK fiscal strain is now a risk for UK defence names
bear_case.description: BAE fell ~4.7% to 1,843p on Oct 6 (~21% below its March peak) after Defence Secretary Healey resigned over slow spending and reports the 3%-of-GDP target could slip; reaching 3% from ~2.3% needs roughly £17.3B more funding. It has since recovered to ~1,950p, but the funding question is unresolved.
bear_case.counter: Roughly half of BAE's revenue is U.S.-linked and the order book is multi-year, so near-term revenue is less exposed than the share price implies.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: BAE Systems
positions.note: The record £84.0B backlog and raised guidance (Oct 4) are intact and shares have recovered to ~1,950p from 1,843p on Oct 6, but UK funding for the 3% target is unresolved (Healey resigned over slow spending) and consensus is Hold — still the least-disputed name, with ~half of revenue U.S.-linked. Directly accessible on UK platforms with no wrapper needed.

positions.name: Kratos Defense
positions.note: The Sep 26 CCA production award keeps GE GEK800 engine optionality alive, but shares sit near $40 (-48% YTD) as the drone ETF fell ~5% on Oct 14 and a cash-hungry production ramp threatens margins — small size only. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: AeroVironment
positions.note: A Sep 9 beat ($0.59 vs. $0.22 EPS) and the $464.8M laser award haven't stopped a slide to ~$122 (-49% YTD, -3% on Oct 14); no new evidence of execution yet, so small size only. Also sits in the Robotics sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.note: At $240.50 (Oct 15) the stock hugs its $232 52-week low; the ~$6B THAAD propulsion and record rocket-motor awards are real, but the CR freezes THAAD production starts and Golden Dome funding — a price worth watching, not yet a confirmed thesis. Also sits in the Space sleeve via satellite work — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Rheinmetall
positions.note: A ~20% one-week rebound to €1,090 (Oct 16) from ~€930 removes much of the dip-buying case, and Berenberg's Hold (€1,020 target), delivery delays and the F126 loss stay unresolved until Q3 results on Nov 5 — wait for evidence. Directly accessible from the UK without a wrapper.

positions.name: Palantir
positions.note: Held near its record at $208.67 (Oct 13, ~60% up in three months) with Q2 revenue +93% and Q3 guided to ~$2.16B, but at ~85x forward earnings the margin of safety is thin — good business, wrong price for now. Also anchors the AI sleeve — don't double-count. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Ondas Holdings
positions.note: Over $270M of orders since Jun 30 and the Regna AI/Palantir venture (no disclosed terms) haven't lifted the stock, which fell ~6% on Oct 14 to ~$6.0 (-35% YTD) because much of the backlog is acquired or stock-funded — the evidence still doesn't support owning it here. Needs a US wrapper.

positions.name: Red Cat Holdings
positions.note: H1 revenue of $35.7M against a $150M full-year target needs an unusually steep ramp, the TRICHON debut brought no contract and shares slid to ~$4.7 (Oct 14) while private Neros took a ~$100M order — the research doesn't support owning it here. Needs a US wrapper.
